clips.caption:
Before Kevin Trudeau taught anyone anything, he tested himself first.

He didn't teach one seminar until he'd made over $15 million on his own. Then he spent $30,000 on blood work, an MRI, CAT scans, hormone panels, even a hair mineral analysis.

The results: his arteries showed about 1% calcification. Autopsies on average 18-year-olds from the Vietnam era showed 40 to 50%. His doctors called it impossible.

That's when he finally wrote Natural Cures.

Would you test yourself before you taught anyone anything?

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the truly rich never arrived alone.

Every one he's met belongs to a private group: Skull and Bones at Yale, the Harvard Alumni Club, the Freemasons, or groups like the Young Presidents' Organization.

It isn't the secrecy that matters. It's the room. A group of ambitious, positive, big-dreaming people multiplies what any one of them could do by themselves.

He calls it the exponential effect of power.

Who's in your room right now?

#kevintrudeau #secretsocieties #mindset #networking #successhabits #wealthmindset
